title: Exercise (language-neutral facts)
description: Validates data/exercises/<id>.yaml. Enum values originating from vocab/*.yaml are NOT duplicated here — they are dynamically loaded by the validator at runtime from the vocabulary files. A second set of truth would inevitably become inconsistent over time.

id.description: Legacy IDs from wger are numeric and remain unchanged. New custom exercises receive 'x-' + 12 hex characters (UUIDv5 derived from the slug, truncated) — ensuring they never collide with future wger IDs.

merged_into.description: Required when status == merged. Target ID.

load_mode.description: What the logged number represents — external, bodyweight, assisted, or variable. Without this field, an assisted machine cannot be distinguished from a weight machine, and analytics would read progress backwards.

supports_added_weight.description: Optional capability, not the default: pull-ups can be done with a belt. Requires load_mode: bodyweight (Invariant 24).

contribution.description: Optional and intentionally empty in v1. Only populate once the assignments themselves are stable — otherwise decimal points are debated while 189 exercises still lack muscles entirely.

aliases.description: Previously issued IDs pointing to this exercise. Becomes exercise_aliases during DB build.

exceptions.description: Mitigates a SOFT invariant for this specific exercise. Key is `invariant_<number>`, value is the justification in plain text. Only soft invariants can be excepted: hard rules are structural and have no legitimate exceptions. An exception without justification is an error; an exception that does not match is a warning — preventing orphan entries nobody can trace.

provenance.description: Field name -> provenance. Field names are top-level keys in this file.

upstream.description: License provenance of the origin entry. null for newly created exercises. See SCHEMA.md 3b.

source_fields.description: Raw values from the source that do not (yet) have a dedicated field in the new model. Preserved losslessly during import so Phase 2 can derive them without re-querying the API — and so the build can populate the category_name compatibility column without depending on the snapshot. After derivation, they remain as reference and are never modified.

category.description: wger `category.name`. Conflates body region and training type (SCHEMA.md 1) and is therefore not adopted directly, only preserved. Populates compatibility column category_name.

equipment.description: wger `equipment[].name`. A flat set without distinguishing primary_equipment / setup; derivation belongs in Phase 2.

vocabRef.description: Must exist in the corresponding vocab/*.yaml. Checked by validator, not by JSON Schema.
